verdict.rationale: Reflect's only evidenced multi-item operations are bulk import from several formats, bulk export to HTML/Markdown, and AI chat over a filtered set of notes to extract information. Its API is limited to appending data and listing bookmarks, so there is no programmatic route to bulk changes. Missing for 10: bulk edit/tag/move/delete across selected notes, bulk AI transformations applied to many notes, an API or automation that supports batch operations, and independent hands-on corroboration.
